name: Button Mash
description: Emulator software picks (no ROMs, software only).

emulators.name: EmulatorJS
emulators.notes: The engine behind this site's Player. 20+ systems in a web page; embed on any site.
emulators.distribution: Loaded at runtime from the EmulatorJS CDN (cdn.emulatorjs.org, stable channel); cores are not redistributed or self-hosted by Button Mash. The GPL allows self-hosting; the site stays on the CDN deliberately (research dossier section 3.4), and every core's own licence stands.

core_licenses.Snes9x (SNES): Snes9x licence: free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs the authors' written permission
core_licenses.Genesis Plus GX (Genesis / Sega CD): Modified BSD-style licence, non-commercial use (libretro port)

emulators.name: RetroArch
emulators.notes: All-in-one frontend: install once, add one core per system. Shaders, netplay, run-ahead latency reduction, RetroAchievements.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: mGBA
emulators.notes: The accuracy king for GBA; also the core in this site's Player and Converter. No BIOS needed.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: SameBoy
emulators.notes: Cycle-accurate Game Boy / Color emulation, beautifully maintained.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: Mesen
emulators.notes: The most accurate NES emulator ever made, with a legendary debugger. Also covers SNES/GB.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.bios_note: Dump from your own PlayStation hardware. Never download one.
emulators.name: DuckStation
emulators.notes: Modern, fast PlayStation emulator with gorgeous upscaling. Relicensed Sept 2024: GPL-3.0 until then, now source-available under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (not open source).
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing. Its CC BY-NC-ND licence is exactly why the web PS1 core here is PCSX-ReARMed instead.

emulators.bios_note: Dump from your own PS2 hardware. Never download one.
emulators.name: PCSX2
emulators.notes: The long-reigning PS2 emulator, still actively improved.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: PPSSPP
emulators.notes: Plays the PSP library at HD resolutions on almost anything.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: Dolphin
emulators.notes: GameCube and Wii emulation at HD resolutions. One of the most polished emulators ever made.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: webretro
emulators.notes: RetroArch cores in the browser via a clean web frontend. Good alternative embedding option.
emulators.distribution: Reference only: Button Mash links the project's own page and distributes nothing.

emulators.name: js-dos (DOSBox)
emulators.notes: The engine behind the DOS corner: DOSBox compiled to WebAssembly. Drop a ZIP or folder of your own DOS game; the corner builds a .jsdos bundle in your browser and boots it. DOSBox-X exists for Windows 3.x guests and is reserved, not default.
emulators.distribution: Loaded at runtime from the js-dos CDN (v8.js-dos.com); not redistributed by Button Mash. Bundles built from the visitor's own files are the visitor's.
